delivery.en: Use the local post or a courier; official BVI doorstep rules were not found. Money is in US dollars
delivery.zh: 可走當地郵局或快遞；官方上門規則沒找到。貨幣是美元

readback.en: After 284, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero; US dollars, not EC dollars; 12-hour time; day first
readback.zh: 284 號碼照 3-3-4 唸，0 唸 zero；美元非東加勒比元；12 時制；先日後月

fraud.en: A WhatsApp message fishing for personal or banking details, as BVI government has warned, is a scam
fraud.zh: WhatsApp 用話術套取個人或銀行資料，英屬維京群島政府已警示，都是詐騙

habits.en: British-Caribbean and a little formal, but amounts are in US dollars. Say mobile, not cell. Day before month.
habits.zh: 英式加勒比、稍正式，但金額用美元。說 mobile 不說 cell。日期先日後月。

stall_local.en: The bank app will not let me approve a transfer, and I have no official postal tracking just now.
stall_local.zh: 銀行 App 不讓我核准轉帳，而且手邊暫時沒有官方郵政查件可對。

reason.zh: 鄰近 ECCU 島嶼的貨幣；英屬維京群島用美元
美國轉帳品牌，不是本地政府警示裡的正規付款方式
美國聯邦健保，不宜直接套用
美式用語，當地較常說 mobile

talk_style_diff.en: More formal than US small talk, in British-Caribbean English, but quote dollars, not EC dollars. Be cautious with WhatsApp requests for data.
talk_style_diff.zh: 比美國閒聊正式，用英式加勒比英語，但金額說美元，不是東加勒比元。對 WhatsApp 要資料要謹慎。

uncertain: 只有一則政府 WhatsApp 警示作為本地防詐主來源，郵政投遞細節不足。
日期口頭順序依英式習慣推得。
